notes.subject: ואספו / אספה / אסיר
notes.rationale: Go bapisiša ga modumo wo o theilwego godimo ga אספ: bokellwa—bokello—bakgolegwa; sebopego se a timela ka Sepedi.

notes.subject: יפקדו
notes.rationale: 'ba tla etelwa' — lentšu le le swanago le la setatimeng sa 21: kotlo, go sekasekwa, goba go etelwa ka mohola; mošomo o tee, ditsela tše tharo.

notes.subject: ומרב ימים
notes.rationale: 'ka bontši ba matsatsi' — ge e le nnete 'ka bontši jwa matsatsi', ka mehla e ranngwa 'matsatsi a matelele'.

translation: Gomme ba tla bokellwa, bjalo ka bokello ya bakgolegwa mo sedibeng, gomme ba tla tswalelwa kgolegong; gomme ka morago ga matsatsi a matelele ba tla etelwa.
